data.name: AMANATSU+
data.detailed_description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES


  • Multi-choice, single-ending VN with 1+ hours till credits
  • Star-studded cast of professional Japanese voice talent

STORY


A simple story about young love in the countryside at the height of summer.
Although having lived in the city all his life, circumstances bring the protagonist to the countryside where he falls in love.
As the days go by, the end of summer soon approaches—along with the Nanakayama festival.

"I'll... be Master's maid, meow!"
"Come on over and be the zombie!"
(W-Were summer festivals always this chaotic...?!)

Though unaccustomed to local events, the protagonist throws himself headfirst into the festivities alongside the girls.
Summer is coming to an end, but a palpable heat continues to linger over Nanakayama.
A time for all sorts of first experiences, like visiting your girlfriend and going on shopping dates.
These joyful days spent with your girlfriend aren't over yet.

CHARACTERS


Kazuha Ainokura
Yukari Aoyama

Kazuha Ainokura, the protagonist's adorable tsundere fiancée, known around Kagowatashi for her sharp quips.
Tends to show her true self whenever the two are alone together, like a true maiden.
Even as the second semester begins, she falls even deeper in love with the protagonist.
The more they talk about their future together, the more she grows as a woman.

Kogane Amahara
Hana Akino

Kogane Amahara, a pure and innocent girl at heart, though she does her best to hide it.
But much to her chagrin, the protagonist is able to see right through her.
When in a group, she loves to be loud and boisterous, but whenever you're alone together, she suddenly shows a more docile side.

Yashiro Kaminashi
Roro Amari

Through her relationship with the protagonist, Yashiro has become more honest with her feelings.
Alongside her parents, Popponchi, and Kou—the Kaminashi household remains as lively as ever.
As the days go by, she gradually grows more comfortable with letting her boyfriend pamper her.
Despite the almost sacred aura surrounding her sometimes, the occasional glimpses of her cute side packs an equally destructive punch.

data.short_description: A story of adventure and young love by fan-favorite developers AZARASHI SOFTWARE. The protagonist returns to his nostalgic yet somewhat unfamiliar hometown, reuniting with past friends, stirring old feelings, and even finding love over the course of this fleeting summer's dream.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 or later, NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 or later, AMD Radeon Pro 555 or later
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 or later, NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 or later, AMD Radeon Pro 555 or later
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Contains occasional crude humor, crass language. All love interests are 18 years of age or older.
